scope: Episode-bound clearance lane partner preference during true resume
finding: Clearance admission reads resumePairs from the matched CLEAR operation/episode roster and prioritises its participants, but later CombatPairs rebuilt actual pairs from CBE_CombatPairs alone. A lagging general registry can therefore preserve older intact pair combinations even when all intended participants survived the resume admission.
counterexample: With eligible roster A,B,C,D, matched clearance lanes A+B/C+D and lagging general pairs A+C/B+D, participant ordering alone cannot prevent the old helper preserving A+C/B+D.
implementation: CombatPairs gains optional fourth preferred-pair array, default empty and bounded to16rows. Before the existing general-registry pass, only intact preferred pairs wholly within already-qualified remaining actors are retained. All other actor eligibility, orphan repair, nearest selection, out-of-scope preservation and publication stay unchanged. CortexClearBuilding passes its matched resumePairs only when useResumeRoster is true, inside the existing commitPreparation gate. Ordinary/new-clear callers retain empty preference.
authority: Metadata preference only, no native command/target/route, no changed eligibility or new recruitment. Existing building/transform/hard-deadline/visit-context roster binding and RESUME_ROSTER_CHANGED admission checks remain. No pair preference can return actors outside the supplied eligible set.
cost: At most16 extra preferred rows on explicit use; no world query, ray, worker, timer or scan of unsupplied actors. Normal default preference loop is empty. Runtime/performance budget unmeasured.
remaining: Does not establish ordered public snapshots, latest-roster replication, full entry/sweep route-state adoption or physical normal/HC continuity. New-member floor/entry receipts remain mandatory. Master build-out figures not renewed.

validation.note: Existing resume contract extended; two guarded call-signature assertions updated after initial full failure. Final pipeline passed.

laneContinuationTrace20261024.scope: Current lane rebuild and shared pending-room allocation; no renewed family score or physical claim.
confirmed: CortexClearBuilding initializes pairRoutes as empty arrays, pending as reconstructed remaining routeOrder and each pairState with cursor0, mover0, time progress/start clocks and entry defaults.
BuildingOperationStep mutates lane route claims by removing a room from pending and appending it to the lane route. Shared visits/unreachable history do not preserve that partition.
Lane state has initial13fields and runtime fields13bestDistance/14bestTarget. Index3 lastProgress and6 startAt are machine-local time; directly publishing/adopting them would use another owner clock.

Cursor0, approachingEntry1, positionSlots2, progress3, retry4, lastTarget5, startAt6, moverSlot7, previousPosition8, entrance9, triedEntrances10, roomCount11, entered12 and optional distance13/target14 are interdependent with pair identity and its claimed route.
Partner ClearEntryRecovery receipt separately retains original server progress time, spent retry, target and ASL anchor; it is not a whole-lane snapshot.

BuildingActorMotion adoption compares actual current native MOVE/HOLD and matching episode; that protects command ownership but does not restore room claim allocation or original pending request timing.
laneContinuationTrace20261024.consequence: Do not restore a cursor/timer alone into the freshly empty route and reconstructed pending queue. That could skip or redirect room work, renew stalled-leg handling or attribute one actor slot to another.

laneJournalImplementation20261024.implementation: BuildingLaneJournal SAVE/ADOPT wired at worker startup and existing owned callback tail. laneJournalImplementation20261024.authority: Current CLEAR generation/epoch, visit nonce, transform and original hard deadline. Failed entry/sweep adoption refuses startup; refusal cleanup remains inside original preparation gate and cannot release a successor. ADOPT changes metadata only; actual actor-native motion/settings/visit proofs remain separate. Egress retains its existing independent journal.
laneJournalImplementation20261024.entrances: Current preparation sorts and truncates exits around the new leader. Saved ordered entry nodes and entry goal are therefore restored only when still in the full currently discovered securityEntries set; lane entrance/tried indices cannot be applied to a new door ordering.
laneJournalImplementation20261024.cost: Existing callback, at most one successful SAVE sample per1.5s and changed-only publication; at most8lanes/2actors and512nodes. Uses maps for live-room partition membership and retirement membership. No world queries, native commands, extra worker or retry/deadline reset. Copy/validation/replication cost is unmeasured.
laneJournalImplementation20261024.limits: Snapshots can be stale or delayed; no ordered delivery/owner-ready ACK. Exact changed roster/node/entrance mismatch refuses rather than recasts state. New actor admission still uses separate receipts. Original pending native request timing is not added to this snapshot. No exactly-once cross-owner movement, casualty continuity, physical re-entry, performance or complete lane-transfer claim.
